latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — convert still images to animated videos with a fast, easy cloud workflow.

- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or GIF files (up to 200MB) and prompt for automatic video creation.
- No manual editing — just describe your desired video and download a 1080p MP4.
- Automatic setup: handles authentication, session creation, and cloud rendering behind the scenes.
- Supports batch upload, timeline editing, transitions, audio tracks, and text overlays.
- Clean user feedback for common actions: upload, export, check credits, view timeline state.
- Clear error handling and usage tips for content creators and marketers.
